links.outcome: Concordance of LLM recommendations with ESGO-ESTRO-ESP 2025 guideline-based reference standard
links.effect: Fully concordant recommendations in 65.7% Gemini, 2.9% ChatGPT, 8.6% Claude; median scores 2, 1, 0 (P < .001).

links.outcome: Recognition of missing decisive information in vignettes
links.effect: Gemini identified need for additional data in 83.3% of cases versus 50.0% for both ChatGPT and Claude.
links.quote: In the subset of vignettes with intentionally missing decisive information, Gemini identified the need for additional data in 83.3% of cases, compared with 50.0% for both ChatGPT and Claude.

links.outcome: Major safety issues in LLM responses against expert reference standard
